constant_fold_graph: constant fold a torch fx graph module to replace computable nodes with constant tensors
build_constant_folder: build a ConstantFolder instance to interpret and fold constants in a torch fx graph module
run_constant_folding_pass: run the constant folding pass on a torch fx graph module to eliminate dead constant computations
test_impure_operation: test whether a torch fx node target is an impure operation that should not be constant folded
replace_node_with_constant: replace a torch fx graph node with a constant buffer attribute in the graph module
